I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random. I said I'd noted that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June and that I hadn't changed anything else.

I didn't take any further action, since she said none was needed. I didn't open or repost to #north-team, and I didn't repeat her earlier date anywhere. A renewal date is an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so confirming it in that channel was allowed.
